priceNote: Tiers follow the standing table the client's own captions land on and that the 2 Sep import already used: fan R500 (S-4XL), fan long sleeve R600 (S-4XL), player R650 (S-2XL), player long sleeve R750 (S-2XL), retro R700 (S-2XL), hoodie / half-zip / sweatshirt R850, jacket or windbreaker R1000, training set R700 (R600 for a vest set), kids R450. captionNote: Client captions for these three batches, in order of arrival: 3 Sep — kids set, hoodie, fan version, training set, half zip, fan version long sleeve, retro, windbreaker, player version long sleeve, fan version, kids set, 'All bayern items'. 4 Sep 2:28 PM — windbreaker, fan version long, fan version goalkeeper, fan version long sleeve, fan version, player long sleeve, kids set, training set, retro, retro long sleeve, hoodie, goalkeeper fan version long sleeve. 4 Sep 2:30 PM — player version long sleeve, fan version, kids set. 4 Sep 4:47-4:51 PM — retro, retro long sleeve, windbreaker, fan version, player version, kids sets, fan version long sleeve, training sets, half zip.
